name: SmartIsland - iOS Dynamic Island
summary: Interactive Apple iOS Dynamic Island notifications and pill for Android
description:
SmartIsland brings the Apple iPhone Dynamic Island interaction model to any Android device. It turns your punch-hole camera cutout into a fluid, responsive floating pill.

Features:
* Music playback controls with animated frequency visualizer
* Incoming phone call notifications with instant answer/reject actions
* Timer and stopwatch countdown live activities
* Battery charging animations and percentage status
* Expandable pill with long-press gesture interactions
* Customizable position, size, and notch alignment

name: BlueBubbles - iMessage for Android
summary: Send and receive Apple iMessages and FaceTime calls on Android
description:
BlueBubbles is an open-source ecosystem client that brings Apple iMessage to Android. Communicate seamlessly with iPhone users without losing any of Apple's flagship messaging features.

Features:
* Full iMessage support: Send and receive texts, voice notes, stickers, and high-res media
* Tapbacks: Love, like, dislike, laugh, emphasize, and question reactions
* Typing indicators and read receipts in real-time
* FaceTime integration: Receive incoming FaceTime calls directly on Android
* Direct message replies and message editing support
* End-to-end encrypted connection to your private bridge

name: Folio Launcher - iOS SpringBoard
summary: Clean Apple iOS 17/18-style SpringBoard launcher for Android
description:
Folio Launcher is a minimalist, iPhone-inspired SpringBoard launcher designed to replicate the visual polish and fluid physics of Apple iOS on Android.

Features:
* Authentic iOS SpringBoard grid with rounded squircle app icons
* iOS-style App Library with automated categorization and alphabetical search
* iOS widget stacking support and home screen editing mode (jiggle mode)
* Fluid spring physics and transition animations
* Support for foldables, tablets, and standard Android smartphones

name: WarpShare - Apple AirDrop Client
summary: Native Apple AirDrop file transfer sender and receiver for Android
description:
WarpShare enables high-speed, local peer-to-peer file sharing between Android and Apple devices (Mac, iPhone, iPad) using the native Apple AirDrop protocol.

Features:
* Send files, photos, and videos to Apple devices running macOS or iOS
* Discovered seamlessly in Apple's native AirDrop sharing sheet
* Uses local Wi-Fi / AWDL direct transfers with maximum throughput
* Zero external servers, zero cloud uploads, completely private and offline
* Material You UI paired with Cupertino device discovery icons

name: AirGuard - AirTag & Find My Protection
summary: Protect against unwanted Apple AirTag and Find My tracking
description:
AirGuard protects Android users against unwanted tracking by Apple AirTags, Apple Find My accessories, and Bluetooth beacons. Developed by the Secure Mobile Networking Lab (SEEMOO) at TU Darmstadt.

Features:
* Background scanning for nearby Apple AirTags and Find My network trackers
* Automatic alerts when a tracker has been following you over multiple locations
* Play alarm sound directly on the suspect AirTag to locate it easily
* Interactive map showing where and when the tracker was detected
* Instructions on how to safely disable suspect trackers

name: OpenHaystack Mobile - Find My Network
summary: Track custom Bluetooth tags using Apple's crowdsourced Find My network
description:
OpenHaystack Mobile allows tracking DIY AirTags and personal Bluetooth beacons using Apple's massive Find My network directly from an Android device.

Features:
* Track OpenHaystack devices broadcast via Bluetooth LE
* Map view showing current and historical locations
* Compatible with ESP32, nRF51/nRF52, BBC micro:bit, and Raspberry Pi Pico beacons
* Zero dependence on Apple iPhone hardware

name: Cupertino Calculator - iOS Calculator
summary: Pixel-perfect recreation of the Apple iOS Calculator for Android
description:
Cupertino Calculator is a faithful recreation of Apple's default iOS Calculator app for Android.

Features:
* Iconic circular orange and dark-gray keypad layout
* Swipe gesture across the display digits to delete characters
* Landscape orientation switches seamlessly into Apple's Scientific Calculator
* Native iOS haptic feedback on button presses
* San Francisco typography and Apple Human Interface Guidelines styling

name: iOS Control Center
summary: Apple iOS frosted-glass Control Center overlay with quick toggles
description:
iOS Control Center provides a fluid Apple-style Control Center swipe panel on Android.

Features:
* Swipe down from top-right corner or edge handle to reveal
* Frosted glass backdrop blur effect matching iOS 17/18
* Large volume and brightness vertical sliders with smooth animation
* Quick connectivity platter: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Airplane mode, Cellular data
* Media playback widget with track details and play/pause/skip
* Flashlight, Calculator, Camera, Screen Record, and Do Not Disturb shortcuts

name: Cupertino Notes - iOS Notes
summary: Apple iOS Notes recreation with rich text, folders, and yellow accents
description:
Cupertino Notes brings the elegance of Apple's iOS Notes app to Android.

Features:
* Classic yellow-accented Apple notepad aesthetic with paper texture
* Folder hierarchy: iCloud, On My Device, and Quick Notes
* Checklists, bullet lists, numbered lists, and title/heading typography
* Pin favorite notes to the top of your list
* Encrypted local storage with biometric lock (Fingerprint/Face Unlock)
* Markdown export and sharing options

name: Infinity - Apollo Experience
summary: The closest open-source equivalent to Apollo for Reddit on Android
description:
Infinity for Reddit provides Android users with the fluid, gesture-first experience that made the iOS-exclusive Apollo for Reddit famous.

Features:
* Full swipe gestures to upvote, downvote, save, collapse comments, and reply
* Clean compact card and media views inspired by iOS Apollo
* Lazy Mode: Smooth automated scrolling through posts and media
* Deep theme customization with OLED true dark mode
* Multi-account support and custom API key integration

name: touchHLE - iOS App Emulator
summary: High-level emulator for early iPhone OS / iOS apps and games
description:
touchHLE is an open-source, high-level emulator designed to run early iPhone OS and iOS apps (such as classic Super Monkey Ball, Rolando, Doom Classic, and early 32-bit apps) directly on modern Android devices.

Features:
* Run decrypted .ipa and .app bundles with native ARM performance
* Built-in graphical app launcher for Android
* Full touch screen and multi-touch support recreating the iPhone experience
* OpenAL-based high fidelity audio emulation
* Hardware accelerated OpenGL ES graphics rendering

name: Spotube - Apple Music Experience
summary: Apple Music-inspired music client with synced lyrics and Cupertino UI
description:
Spotube is a modern, privacy-respecting music player that delivers an Apple Music-like experience on Android with stunning Cupertino aesthetics.

Features:
* Apple Music-styled frosted glass now-playing sheet with fluid gradient backgrounds
* Real-time time-synced karaoke lyrics with line-by-line animations
* Zero audio ads, completely free and open source
* High-bitrate audio playback with local caching and offline downloads
* Clean Cupertino-inspired design system
